components.name: League Connection & Identity Management
components.description: Core system for connecting external fantasy leagues to FSHQ, creating league spaces, managing unique URLs, and establishing league identity and visibility settings

subcomponents.name: Fantasy League Integration & Detection
subcomponents.description: Connect external fantasy platforms (Sleeper), fetch league metadata, detect existing FSHQ instances, and establish league connections
tracesTo: UserFlow: Commissioner League Linking & Admin Creation

subcomponents.name: League URL & Branding
subcomponents.description: Generate unique league slugs (fshq.gg/LEAGUESLUG), handle collisions, support admin edits, and manage league branding/identity
tracesTo: UserFlow: Commissioner League Linking & Admin Creation

subcomponents.name: League Configuration & Visibility
subcomponents.description: Manage league visibility rules (public/private), join rules (auto-join/approval), fan access settings, and league-level configuration

components.name: User Onboarding & Access Control
components.description: Complete user authentication, role assignment, team claiming, membership approval, and multi-league navigation system

subcomponents.name: User Registration & Login
subcomponents.description: Email/password authentication via Supabase Auth, session management, and account creation flows
tracesTo: UserFlow: Manager / Fan Onboarding, Claiming & Role Assignment

subcomponents.name: Team Claiming & Role Selection
subcomponents.description: Manager team claiming by platform username/ID, fan role selection with optional team support, multi-user per team support, and claim validation
tracesTo: UserFlow: Manager / Fan Onboarding, Claiming & Role Assignment

subcomponents.name: Membership Approval Workflows
subcomponents.description: Admin approval queues, auto-join vs manual approval based on league rules, claim release/reassignment, and role promotion/demotion
tracesTo: UserFlow: Manager / Fan Onboarding, Claiming & Role Assignment

subcomponents.name: Multi-League Switcher & Navigation
subcomponents.description: League switcher for users in multiple leagues, direct routing for single-league users, and league context management
tracesTo: UserFlow: League Access, Switching & Role-Based Experience

components.name: Social Feed & Community Engagement
components.description: Central newsfeed with league moments, user posts, engagement mechanics (comments/reactions), and content moderation tools

subcomponents.name: Newsfeed & Moment Generation
subcomponents.description: Chronological engagement-aware feed, automated league moments (trades, results), commissioner posts, user-generated content, and feed sorting/bumping
tracesTo: UserFlow: Weekly Member Engagement, Feed Interaction, Pick'ems & History Browsing

subcomponents.name: Comments & Reactions System
subcomponents.description: Comment threading, emoji reactions, engagement bumping, and interaction tracking on all moment types
tracesTo: SOW: User Interactions - Content Creation & Engagement

subcomponents.name: User-Generated Posts
subcomponents.description: Create text posts, add media (future), polls (future), memes, links, and basic post formatting
tracesTo: SOW: User Interactions - Content Creation & Engagement

subcomponents.name: Admin Content Moderation
subcomponents.description: Pin moments to top of feed, hide/remove problematic content, and manage feed quality
tracesTo: UserFlow: League Access, Switching & Role-Based Experience
